informative.title: Expand NaN gaps by a time radius
informative.summary: Marks samples near original missing samples as NaN while preserving signal alignment.
informative.description: Expands each original NaN run symmetrically by a sample radius obtained from a duration and the sampling frequency.
notes: Only original NaN samples generate expansion; newly marked samples do not generate additional expansion.
The normative contract is one-dimensional. Independent column-wise matrix processing may be provided as an implementation-specific extension.

definitions.text: Compute radius = round_half_away_from_zero(sampling_frequency * expansion_duration). Exact nonnegative half-way values round upward. expansion_duration applies independently on each side of an original NaN run.
Identify NaN positions in the original signal before changing any output sample.

Copy signal. Set output sample i to NaN if an original NaN occurs at sample j with abs(i - j) <= radius. Clip expansion to the input sample range and unite overlapping expanded spans. Newly generated NaNs do not trigger further expansion. All other samples retain their exact original values.

behavior.nan_handling: NaN samples are allowed and generate symmetric gap expansion. Infinite values and complex data in any input are invalid. Validate all inputs even when signal is empty or contains no NaNs.
behavior.empty_input: An empty signal returns an empty expanded_signal without warnings when the other inputs are valid.
behavior.input_orientation: Row and column vectors represent the same canonical one-dimensional sequence. expanded_signal is aligned sample-by-sample with signal and has the same length. Physical vector orientation and optional matrix support are implementation-specific.
behavior.insufficient_data: No minimum nonempty length is required. An all-NaN signal remains all NaN without warnings. A signal without NaNs, a zero duration, or a radius rounded to zero preserves every input value.
